items.title: Wall St banks turn on each other as capital fight nears endgame
items.summary: WASHINGTON, Aug 27 (Reuters) - Wall Street's most powerful banks fought side by side for years to relax capital rules, but with victory in sight, that alliance has fractured. As the Federal Reserve wraps up a sweeping overhaul of capital rules, JPMorgan, Bank of America, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are feuding over a tweak with billions of dollars at stake, according to public documents and ‌four people familiar with the matter.
